approved_scope.title: Fix 269
acceptance_criteria: A session started with chough session new and no objective holds the placeholder as its '# ...' title and its Goal; the first chough checkpoint --objective replaces each that still holds the untouched placeholder with the objective, so the archived story and its journal post carry the objective and never the placeholder. A later objective change rewrites neither, and a Goal or title a person wrote is kept byte for byte.
